intro: The Astral table is your one-stop-shop for conversations. Its tempered glass top and lustrous chrome legs create a light, airy ambiance, perfect for casual meals or formal settings with equal charm​.

features.title: Tempered glass for strength
features.text: The tempered glass top is impact-resistant and durable, offering lasting quality and peace of mind for your everyday use.

features.title: Chrome legs for stability
features.text: Chrome-plated metal legs provide lasting support, resist corrosion, and bring a sleek look to your dining space.

features.title: Sleek and space-saving design
features.text: Tight on space? No problem. The circular design fits smaller rooms perfectly while keeping things stylish and practical.

features.title: Versatile for any setting
features.text: Whether it’s a dinner party or casual meal, the compact design works beautifully in any setting.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Astral 4-Seater Tempered Glass Circular Dining Table
